name: omnilab/hgnc
description: Omnilab HGNC: a human gene by its HGNC id (HGNC:4827), approved, previous or alias symbol, or an id HGNC records (NCBI Gene, Ensembl, UniProt, OMIM) - its approved name, locus group and type, location, previous symbols and names, aliases, gene groups, status, dates, MANE Select, RefSeq and CCDS ids - its NCBI Gene, Ensembl, UniProt and OMIM ids as cross-references, and a search, through HGNC's REST service, no key needed.
